summary: sysatlas is a Python library for architecture diagrams. Pydantic-backed builders describe a system, and a layout and routing engine renders it as interactive draw.io HTML. A reverse flow reads existing code and produces the same diagrams, plus a deterministic text atlas of the architecture. Only the names exported from the root package are public; modules that start with an underscore are private.

bpmn_map.purpose: Fluent builder for BPMN process diagrams. Hands layout and rendering to the BPMN pipeline.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

class_map.purpose: Fluent builder for UML class diagrams. Uses the shared layered engine for layout.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

er_map.purpose: Fluent builder for entity-relationship diagrams. Uses the shared layered engine for layout.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

reflection.purpose: The reflection engine: the Reflection object, hints, graph metrics, component clustering, layer rules, the atlas model and its Markdown writer, merge with a hand-written overlay, and the Rust parser. Builds SystemMap and System objects but does not render them.

sequence_map.purpose: Fluent builder for UML sequence diagrams. Hands layout and rendering to the sequence pipeline.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

state_map.purpose: Fluent builder for state machine diagrams. Uses the shared layered engine for layout.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

tree_map.purpose: Fluent builder for trees, org charts and mind maps. Hands layout and rendering to the tree pipeline.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

bpmn-pipeline.purpose: Lays out BPMN diagrams (pools, lanes, events, gateways) and writes their mxGraph XML. Has its own layout; does not use the layered engine.

parser.purpose: Reads Python source with ast, without importing it, and records each module's imports, symbols, docstring, entry points, data models and environment reads.

project.purpose: Reads the console scripts declared in the nearest pyproject.toml.

sequence-pipeline.purpose: Lays out UML sequence diagrams (lifelines, messages, activations) and writes their mxGraph XML. Has its own layout; does not use the layered engine.

spec.purpose: Holds the planned architecture from the hints file and checks the code's import edges against it.

system.purpose: Multi-view architecture description (ISO 42010): views, viewpoints, stakeholders, and trace links across views, with stub nodes for cross-view references. Builds on SystemMap.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

tree-pipeline.purpose: Lays out tree diagrams and writes their mxGraph XML. Has its own layout; does not use the layered engine.

_trace_matrix.purpose: Renders trace links between components as an HTML matrix of sources by targets.

external.purpose: Maps import names to kinds of external system: database, HTTP, queue, cloud, model API.

resolve.purpose: Decides whether an import target lives inside the scanned tree.

system_map.purpose: Fluent builder for one architecture diagram. Hands the finished diagram to the layout and render engine.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

_render.purpose: The layered layout and edge-routing engine, and the writer of mxGraph XML and viewer HTML. Every builder depends on it; it depends only on the vendored viewer script.

diagram-types.purpose: Pydantic schemas for each diagram kind: architecture, BPMN, ER, sequence, state machine, tree and UML class. Data only; no layout or rendering.
patterns: Fluent builder over a typed schema

_vendor.purpose: Finds the draw.io viewer script, downloading and caching it when it is missing.

cross-cutting.purpose: Schemas that apply across diagram kinds: ISO 42010 architecture description, trace links, quality attributes and the model-kind taxonomy.

patterns.name: Fluent builder over a typed schema
patterns.description: Each builder collects chained calls into a validated Pydantic model, which the engine then renders.

patterns.name: Shared engine with specialized pipelines
patterns.description: Architecture, state, ER and class diagrams go through one layered layout and routing engine. BPMN, sequence and tree diagrams have their own layout and render modules, and reuse only the shared XML and viewer writer.

patterns.name: Deterministic generated artifact
patterns.description: Reflection output is a pure function of the source tree: every list is sorted, nothing depends on time, paths or hash order, so the atlas can be committed and diffed.
